system.description:
Many Toreador assert that their clan curse is no curse at all, but a blessing. A Toreador who regards a scene or work of great beauty is prone to fall into an aesthetic trance, the antithesis of the Beast's ugly fury. A character who knows Bliss can recall beauty almost as intimately as if it were present and use the recollection as a reservoir of inner strength, bolstering herself against frenzy, or project this sense of pleasure onto another to calm his rage or fear.

To use this power, the character must deliberately enter a trance while experiencing a work of art or embodiment of beauty appropriate to the Virtue she wishes to bolster; she remains enthralled until the work ends or is covered. Within one hour or scene after the trance ends, the player makes a Static Mental Challenge against a difficulty equal to double the desired Virtue's permanent rating. Success adds one Trait to Self-Control, Conscience, or Courage (only one at a time) for the remainder of the scene or hour. Used to steel another's resolve, the difficulty is double the target Virtue plus one. Only vampires on the Path of Humanity may learn this power. This power costs seven Experience Traits to learn.
